# Window Repair GTA

> Window, glass and door repair for homes, condos and businesses in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Repair first: we replace foggy or broken glass, cranks, hinges, locks and patio door rollers, and replace whole windows and doors only when needed.

- Phone: (365) 340-4760
- Service area: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville and the GTA
- Fully insured and WSIB covered
- Warranty: 1-year workmanship; 5-year seal warranty on new glass in vinyl frames
- 24/7 emergency service; calls after 10 PM have a $100 after-hours call-out fee
- Free quotes from photos
- Specialty: FAPIM (Italian) condo window hardware, with genuine parts imported from Italy
- Window crank replacement: $150 to $400 per crank, condos at the higher end

## Services
- [Foggy Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/foggy-window-repair/): Moisture between the panes means the seal failed. We replace the sealed glass unit and keep your frame.
- [Window Glass Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-glass-replacement/): Cracked, chipped or broken glass replaced in your existing frame, single or double pane.
- [Patio & Sliding Door Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/patio-door-repair/): Sliding doors that stick, drag or won't lock. New rollers, tracks, handles and door glass.
- [Window Crank & Hardware Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-crank-repair/): Casement cranks, hinges, locks and handles that are stiff, stripped or broken. Cranks from $150.
- [Window Caulking & Drafts](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-caulking/): Cracked exterior caulking and worn weatherstripping let in cold air and water. We reseal them.
- [Window & Door Screens](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-screen-repair/): Torn mesh, bent frames and missing screens, made to measure.
- [Window Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-replacement/): When the frame is past saving, we supply and install new energy-efficient windows.
- [Commercial & Storefront Glass](https://windowrepairgta.ca/commercial-glass-repair/): Storefront glass, office windows and commercial doors for shops, offices and buildings.
- [Emergency Glass Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/emergency-glass-repair/): Broken window after a break-in or storm? We're available 24/7 to secure the opening and replace the glass.
- [FAPIM Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/fapim-window-repair/): Italian FAPIM windows in GTA condos repaired with genuine parts imported from Italy.
- [Tilt & Turn Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/tilt-and-turn-window-repair/): European tilt and turn windows that won't lock, tilt or close tight. Handles, gears and hinges repaired.
- [Window Handle Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-handle-repair/): Loose, cracked or stripped window handles and crank handles replaced to match.
- [Window Hinge Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-hinge-repair/): Bent, seized or sagging casement and awning hinges replaced so the window closes square.
- [Window Lock Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-lock-repair/): Window locks and multi-point locks that won't latch or pull the window tight.
- [Window Latch Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-latch-repair/): Tilt latches, sash latches and slider latches that are broken or won't catch.
- [Entry & Commercial Door Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/door-repair/): Front doors, French doors and commercial doors that stick, drop or won't lock.
- [Front Door Glass](https://windowrepairgta.ca/front-door-glass/): Door glass inserts, sidelites and transoms replaced without replacing the door.
- [Curved & Shaped Glass](https://windowrepairgta.ca/curved-glass-replacement/): Arched, half-round, trapezoid and custom-shaped sealed units made to fit.
- [Wood Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/wood-window-repair/): Rotted sills, damaged sashes and worn wood windows repaired and restored.
- [Window Leaks & Drainage](https://windowrepairgta.ca/window-leak-drainage-repair/): Water coming in around or under a window. We find the source and fix the drainage and seals.
- [New Storm Doors](https://windowrepairgta.ca/storm-doors/): Heavy-duty aluminum storm doors made in Toronto, supplied and installed. From $1,200.
- [Storm Door Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/storm-door-repair/): Storm and screen doors that slam, sag or won't latch, usually fixed in one visit.
- [Skylight Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/skylight-repair/): Leaking, foggy or cracked skylight glass repaired or replaced without a full tear-out.
- [Condo Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/condo-window-repair/): Condo windows, balcony doors and FAPIM hardware fixed from inside your unit, with the building's rules in mind.
- [Patio Door Glass Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/patio-door-glass-replacement/): Foggy or cracked glass in a sliding patio door replaced, without replacing the whole door.
- [Broken Window Glass](https://windowrepairgta.ca/broken-window-glass-replacement/): Cracked or shattered window glass made safe fast, then replaced in your existing frame.
- [Basement Window Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/basement-window-repair/): Broken basement glass, cranks that won't turn, leaks and drafts in basement windows.
- [Front Door Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/front-door-replacement/): New entry doors supplied and installed: steel, fibreglass, with or without glass and sidelites.
- [Patio Door Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/patio-door-replacement/): New sliding and patio doors supplied and installed when the old door can't be repaired.
- [Patio Door Roller Replacement](https://windowrepairgta.ca/patio-door-roller-replacement/): Sliding doors that drag, grind or jump the track, fixed with new rollers and a track tune-up.
- [Storefront & Aluminum Door Repair](https://windowrepairgta.ca/storefront-door-repair/): Aluminum and glass storefront doors that drag, slam, won't latch or have broken glass.

## Guides
- [How to tell if your window seal has failed](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/how-to-tell-window-seal-failed/): Fog between the panes, streaks you can't clean and a cold window are signs a sealed glass unit has failed. How to check, and what it costs to fix.
- [Cracked window glass: replace the pane or the whole window?](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/cracked-window-glass-replace-pane-or-window/): A cracked pane rarely means a new window. When replacing only the glass makes sense, when the window is due, and how to stay safe until it's fixed.
- [Do you need a permit to replace windows or doors in Toronto?](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/permit-to-replace-windows-doors-toronto/): When a building permit is and isn't needed to replace windows and doors in Toronto: houses vs condos and apartments, same-size openings, and new openings.
- [Commercial door slams or won't latch? Door closer basics](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/door-closer-adjustment-commercial-doors/): Why commercial and storefront doors slam, close too slowly or don't latch, what a door closer adjustment fixes, and when the closer needs replacing.
- [How to make a sliding patio door harder to break into](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/sliding-patio-door-security/): Sliding doors are a common way into GTA homes. Simple fixes that make them much harder to force: locks, keepers, track bars, pins and glass.
- [Mould on window sills: why it grows and how to stop it](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/mold-on-window-sills/): Black spots on window sills and frames come from condensation that sits too long. How to clean it, stop it coming back, and when the window needs repair.
- [Drafty front door? Weatherstripping, sweeps and thresholds](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/drafty-front-door-weatherstripping/): Cold air around a front door usually comes from worn weatherstripping, a bad door sweep or a door that doesn't close tight. How to find it and fix it.
- [Window won't close or lock? Common causes and fixes](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/window-wont-close-or-lock/): A window that won't close all the way or won't lock is usually a hardware problem, not a reason for a new window. How to find the cause.
- [Window leaking when it rains? How to find where the water gets in](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/window-leaking-when-it-rains/): Water around a window after rain can come from the window, the caulking, blocked drain holes or the wall above. How to tell, and what fixes it.
- [Ice or water on the inside of your windows in winter](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/ice-on-inside-of-windows/): Frost, ice or water on the inside of windows in a GTA winter is usually condensation. What causes it, when it's a window problem, and what helps.
- [Who pays for condo window repairs in Ontario?](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/condo-window-repair-who-pays-ontario/): Condo corporation or unit owner? How Ontario condo declarations usually treat windows, balcony doors and screens, and what to check before you book a repair.
- [FAPIM windows in Toronto condos: what they are and how to fix them](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/fapim-windows-toronto-condos/): Many GTA condo windows use FAPIM hardware from Italy. How to recognize it, why the vents stop staying open or locking, and why genuine parts matter.
- [Why is there condensation between my window panes?](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/condensation-between-window-panes/): Fog or moisture between double pane glass means the seal has failed. What causes it, whether it can be fixed, and what it costs compared with a new window.
- [Window crank not working? Repair it before you replace the window](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/window-crank-repair-or-replace/): A casement window crank that spins, sticks or won't close is almost always a worn operator or hinge. How to tell what's wrong and why a repair beats a new window.
- [Should I repair or replace my windows?](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/repair-or-replace-windows/): A simple guide for GTA homeowners: when a window repair makes sense, when replacement does, and how to tell the difference.
- [Sliding patio door hard to open? 5 causes and how to fix them](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/sliding-patio-door-hard-to-open/): Why sliding patio doors drag, grind or jump the track, what you can fix yourself, and when the rollers need replacing.
- [Drafty windows: where the cold air gets in and how to stop it](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/drafty-windows-where-cold-air-gets-in/): Find exactly where cold air leaks into your home around the windows, and the right fix for each spot, from weatherstripping to new glass.
- [Tempered vs. laminated glass: what your windows and doors need](https://windowrepairgta.ca/blog/tempered-vs-laminated-glass/): The difference between regular, tempered and laminated glass, where each is required, and which to choose for security, safety and noise.
